method: Read all 252 exact-position source token analyses and compared the questionable choices with the actual prior sense inventory and reconciled independent translations.
scope_limit: Coordinator source/dependency reconciliation; this is not the later fresh blind learner solve or independent full paradigm review.

findings.issue: gelīefst and U17-RSUP-04 say believe a person instead of permit/allow me to speak.
findings.required_repair: Keep the prior indicative form; supply the evidenced permission sense and dative permission-recipient frame. Correct all derived descriptions and preserve the earlier hypothesis in a separate correction record.

verified_positions.contextual_role_and_meaning: Conditional if the king permits Apollonius to speak; mē is the dative person granted permission, and the speaking is understood from ic sęcge

findings.issue: ðonne is incorrectly bound to comparative than.
findings.required_repair: Bind temporal/consequential then, with a current bounded reading explanation and no unlicensed promotion from a prior narrow source exposure.

verified_positions.contextual_role_and_meaning: ðonne wāst ðū nū ðæt ðū gīet nāst: then you will know what you do not yet know. This locally supplied consequence is distinct from comparative than and from the earlier bounded judgment sequence.

findings.issue: ðæt is incorrectly assigned the definite-article sense se-the.
findings.required_repair: Use the demonstrative object sense with the supported that-which relation; retain the actual prior form identity and its contextual analysis separately.

verified_positions.contextual_role_and_meaning: that which / what you do not yet know; demonstrative object with understood relative relation

findings.issue: on hiere swēgcræfte is glossed as physical dative location.
findings.required_repair: Use the evidenced respect/domain sense and whole praise/blame frame, checking actual prior status before any reuse.

verified_positions.contextual_role_and_meaning: in/with respect to a quality or domain, with dative: musical skill or fields of accomplishment
in/with respect to a quality or domain, with dative: musical skill or fields of accomplishment

findings.issue: on swēgcræft is assigned a physical dative-location gloss despite the supplied figurative accusative-goal expression.
findings.required_repair: Bind a supplied local meaning within gefēoll on swēgcræft; do not claim that a generic prior placement sense alone teaches the idiom.

verified_positions.contextual_role_and_meaning: gefēoll on swēgcræft: chanced upon musical skill. Swēgcræft is accusative; this metaphorical complement is supplied with the whole clause, not treated as ordinary dative location.

findings.issue: on his hand is a destination, not the assigned dative-location meaning.
findings.required_repair: Use the actual prior into/onto goal sense with its case and frame, or supply the complete local expression where its prior teaching is insufficient.

verified_positions.contextual_role_and_meaning: into his hand, destination of taking; accusative hand

findings.issue: swā in sōna swā is explained only as so/thus.
findings.required_repair: Use the bounded temporal-correlative sense and explicit as-soon-as help; the actual prior register has swa-as-correlative-source, whose status must be retained or explicitly promoted.

verified_positions.contextual_role_and_meaning: sōna swā hēo hearpian ongan: as soon as she began to play the harp. Swā belongs to the supplied temporal connective, not an isolated manner so.

related_scope_corrections: on117 also uses the respect/domain sense.
mid17/201 accompaniment and mid193 supplied manner have distinct actual sense identities.
